_howto: Drives the Search menu and its pages. Lifestyle pages list every club (clubs.json) and community without a club (communities.json) whose "tags" include the page's tag, with an All / With a club / Without a club toggle. Membership pages list clubs only. Paste an IDX Broker embed into "idx" to show live listings on a page. Add, remove or reorder entries here and the menu updates.
_menu: "menu" lists what appears under Search, in order. Keys: all, clubs, no-club, new-developments, or any category slug below. Category pages are only built for categories in the menu, so to bring one back (e.g. "gated"), add its slug here. With 6 or fewer items the menu is a single list; with 7 or more it switches to three columns (Find a home / By lifestyle / By membership).

heroSearch._howto: Hero search bar and every Live listings button on the site. action is the IDX Broker results page. fixed is added to every IDX link (pt=sfr is residential, which includes condos). cityIds maps each town to its IDX city ID, so typing a town filters by it; a 5-digit ZIP filters by ZIP. params maps the price and beds fields to IDX field names. tabs can point the With a club / Without a club tabs at IDX saved-link URLs; left empty they open our own club and community pages. Club and community buttons use the MLS subdivision names in src/idx-subdivisions.json.
